summary: The anaphylaxis rule faithfully encodes the >=2-systems / generalised urticaria / serious single-system branches, but counts faint/unwell symptoms without the 'do not improve quickly' gate, so transient vasovagal reactions can become probable anaphylaxis. The pseudoallergic rule negates itching (same skin system) and omits the 30-minute observation condition, leaving isolated itchy hives undiagnosed. Concepts all exist and match the page.
